title: Embeddings turn meaning into geometry
summary: An embedding maps an item to a numeric vector so semantically related items can be found by proximity.
explanation: Embedding models place related text near each other in vector space. Similarity search can therefore retrieve relevant passages even when they do not share exact keywords.
use_case: A RAG system embeds a question and retrieves documentation chunks with nearby vectors before generating an answer.
example: query embedding → cosine similarity → nearest document chunks
question: Why can embedding search retrieve a relevant passage that uses different words from the query?
answer: Because embeddings encode semantic relationships, so similar meanings can have nearby vectors despite different wording.
